Accordion.accessibility: Tab to a heading; Enter or Space toggles its associated region. Collapsed content is hidden from the tab order.

Alert.accessibility: Success/info use status; warning/error use alert. State is communicated through text and an icon, in addition to color.

Button.description: A considered starting point for every action.
Button.accessibility: Native button: Enter and Space activate. Default type is button; set type="submit" for forms. Loading disables activation and exposes aria-busy. Icon-only buttons need an aria-label.

Card.description: A surface with a quiet sense of depth.
Card.accessibility: A noninteractive container. Use an actual link or button for actions; do not attach card-only click interactions. Cursor tracking is opt-in and disabled for reduced motion.

Checkbox.accessibility: Native checkbox supports Space, label activation, indeterminate state, required, name and form submission. React onChange receives the native input event.

Chip.description: A little context, a little color.
Chip.accessibility: Removal is a native button with a specific accessible label. Disabled chips also disable their removal button.

CodeBlock.description: Code that is as useful as it looks.
CodeBlock.accessibility: Scrollable keyboard-focusable code region. Copy reports success/failure in a status region, preserves the original source, and never includes decorative line numbers. Unknown languages and sources over 20,000 characters render as plain text.

ContainerTextFlip.description: Words change. The layout stays composed.
ContainerTextFlip.accessibility: A stable accessible text alternative includes every word. Visible cycling has a pause control, stops offscreen document cycling, and stops for reduced motion. Empty lists render nothing. Longest-word sizing prevents layout shift.

Divider.description: A fine line with a soft edge.
Divider.accessibility: Exposes separator and orientation. Set role="presentation" when purely decorative. The default orientation remains vertical for compatibility.

FloatingMenu.description: Quick access, in just the right place.
FloatingMenu.accessibility: Links navigate; buttons perform actions. Native Tab/Enter/Space behavior, visible focus and aria-current/aria-pressed. Supply useful labels for every item, including icon items.

ImagesBadge.description: A small collection, ready to unfold.
ImagesBadge.accessibility: The label names the collection; preview images are decorative. Linked badges unfold on keyboard focus as well as hover. With no href the badge is display-only. At most three images are shown.

Progress.description: A clear signal of what comes next.
Progress.accessibility: Exposes progressbar, min/max and current value. Omit value for indeterminate progress. Supply a descriptive label; updates do not continuously interrupt screen readers.

RadioGroup.description: One clear choice from a set of possibilities.
RadioGroup.accessibility: Native radio arrow keys select within one uniquely named group. Tab enters/leaves the group; disabled options are skipped. One callback per change. Provide a label or aria-labelledby. Explicit names are intentionally shared only when representing the same form field.

Rating.accessibility: Native radio keyboard interaction. readOnly renders a single image summary. Integer values are clamped; max is bounded to 1–100. This component does not support fractional ratings.

ScreenReveal.description: A second layer, without losing your place.
ScreenReveal.accessibility: The closed reveal layer is hidden and cannot receive focus. Provide an external, labeled toggle with aria-expanded. The front layer remains available; this is a visual layout, not a modal.

SegmentedControl.description: A compact way to choose a view.
SegmentedControl.accessibility: A native radio selection group with arrow keys. Legacy tabs is the options prop name; it does not describe tab panels. Use Tabs when choices reveal associated panels.

Select.accessibility: Native select retains platform keyboard interactions and form validation. Labels, description and error are linked. Size chooses visual dimensions; multiple selection is not supported.

Skeleton.description: A thoughtful pause before the content.
Skeleton.accessibility: Decorative aria-hidden placeholders. Name the loading region outside the skeleton. Shimmer and pulse stop for reduced motion.

Slider.description: Find just the right amount of light.
Slider.accessibility: Native range supports arrows, Home and End. Values are clamped and aligned to step; invalid/reversed bounds and nonfinite numbers normalize safely. React onChange receives a number. step="any" permits continuous values.

TextField.description: An input with room for the details.
TextField.accessibility: Label, description and error are programmatically linked. Validation includes text, not just color. Native composition/autocomplete events pass through. passwordToggle provides a labeled reveal button; fieldSize controls appearance while size retains native input sizing.

Timeline.accessibility: An ordered list keeps all information available during SSR and reduced motion. One transform-only scroll beam uses the optional containerRef; no per-item scroll listeners or measurements are required.

Toggle.accessibility: Button with switch semantics; Space/Enter and associated labels activate. Optional native checkbox participates in form submission/reset and required validation. readOnly preserves focus while preventing changes. onClick is composed and can preventDefault.

Dialog.description: A focused space for important decisions.
Dialog.accessibility: Radix modal: traps Tab focus, makes background inert, closes on Escape/outside interaction and restores trigger focus. A required title names the dialog; description is optional. Supply a ref-forwarding trigger. Open programmatically only after a user action.

Tooltip.description: A helpful detail, right when it is needed.
Tooltip.accessibility: Opens on hover or keyboard focus; Escape dismisses. Content describes its trigger. Use Popover for interactive content and never put essential instructions only in a tooltip. Disabled native buttons do not receive focus; place explanations in nearby text.

Popover.description: Useful context, close to the action.
Popover.accessibility: Radix nonmodal dialog with focus management, collision positioning, Escape/outside dismissal and trigger focus restoration. Required label names the surface. Content may contain native controls. Keep information essential to the page outside the popover.

DropdownMenu.description: Actions that stay out of the way.
DropdownMenu.accessibility: Radix menu: Enter/Space/ArrowDown opens, arrows and Home/End move, typing searches, Escape closes/restores focus. Disabled items are skipped. Use href for navigation and onSelect for actions. Does not expose nested/checkbox/radio menu items.

Tabs.description: Related views with a complete keyboard model.
Tabs.accessibility: Radix tabs associate each tab and panel. Horizontal arrows or vertical Up/Down, Home/End and disabled skipping are supported. activationMode="manual" waits for Enter/Space. Use a unique value for each item.

Toast.accessibility: Radix announcements, timed dismissal, hover/focus/window-blur pause and F8 viewport access. Toast actions require a meaningful altText. Mount one ToastProvider per themed tree; persist critical errors inline. Control open to show a toast in response to an action.

Avatar.description: A familiar face, with a useful fallback.
Avatar.accessibility: Required alt names the person; decorative images share the parent accessible name. Initials remain available if the image fails. AvatarGroup is labeled and announces overflow. No action is implied.

Badge.description: Status that can be read at a glance.
Badge.accessibility: Visible text communicates status; the optional dot is decorative. Static badges do not announce updates automatically. Use a parent live region only for meaningful live changes.

Spinner.accessibility: A status region contains a descriptive, visually hidden label. Rotation stops for reduced motion; the status remains available.

EmptyState.description: An empty space with a useful next step.
EmptyState.accessibility: A semantic heading, descriptive text and optional real action. headingLevel integrates into the document outline. Icons are decorative. There is no automatic focus movement.

Breadcrumbs.description: A clear path back to the bigger picture.
Breadcrumbs.accessibility: A named navigation landmark contains an ordered list. The last crumb exposes aria-current="page"; separators are decorative. Native links retain standard browser behavior.

Pagination.description: A smaller window into a larger collection.
Pagination.accessibility: Named navigation with native buttons and current-page state. Previous/next disable at boundaries. Zero pages render nothing. Large counts render a bounded set; update result announcements/focus in the consuming application.
